title: Changing course with inner steadiness
meaning: Your shared will appears through adapting how you act while preserving patience and the ability to hear each other.
text: Sometimes a decision must be made while change is already happening. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of Manipura describes acting with circumstances: rearranging the sequence, using available time or choosing another route. The Wheel of Fortune in energy identifies the motive, responding to an opportunity and wanting to catch a useful turn. Strength in emotions allows uncertainty to be met with inner steadiness while feelings remain welcome. The first Wheel changes your steps, the second explains your interest in change, and Strength helps you remain together without mutual pressure.

Suppose you intend to paint a shelf together, but the paint you wanted has sold out. The shop has another shade you both like. **Flexibility becomes shared strength when both accept the change.** You can discuss the new colour and calmly adapt the idea. The decision grows from available conditions and agreement, without requiring every surprise to become good fortune or disappointment to be hidden.

The difficulty is treating every opening as something you must use. The plan changes faster than you can understand your response. Steadiness then becomes constant suppression of disagreement, while movement depends on the next external turn. Gentleness supports decisions while including permission to pause and choose. Every change in conditions need not immediately change the intention you share.
